source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Artificial Intelligence (AI) (PDF 108, printed 104).

blocks.text: Artificial Intelligence (AI) computer science ki woh shaakh hai jo machines ko aise kaam karne ke qabil banati hai jin ke liye aam tor par insani zehanat (intelligence) chahiye hoti hai (Figure 8.2). AI computers ko data analyze karne, patterns pehchanne aur kam se kam insani madad se faisle karne deti hai. AI systems tajurbe se seekhte hain; is process ko machine learning kehte hain, jis mein algorithms ko bohat sare data par train kiya jata hai taake woh trends pehchanein aur waqt ke saath behtar hon. System jitna zyada data process kare, us ke nataij utne zyada durust hote hain.

AI data, algorithms aur computing power ko mila kar zaheen kaam karti hai, jaise baat samajhna, tasveeron mein cheezein pehchanna aur nataij ka andaza lagana. Yeh Neural Networks (NN) aur Natural Language Processing (NLP, insani zaban samajhne wali technology) use karti hai taake insani dimagh ki tarah information process kare. Is se AI pecheeda masail hal kar sakti, kaam khud-kaar bana sakti, aur un jagahon par madad kar sakti hai jahan aam programming ghair-yaqeeni surat-e-haal ya bohat zyada information nahi sambhal sakti.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Aam program mein programmer har qadam khud likhta hai. Machine learning mein hum computer ko bohat si misalein (data) dete hain aur woh khud pattern (baar baar aane wala tareeqa) dhoond leta hai. Jaise bachcha bohat si billiyon ki tasveerein dekh kar billi pehchanna seekh jata hai, waise hi AI zyada data se zyada durust (accurate) hoti jati hai.

blocks.prompt: Machine learning kya hai, aur AI ke liye zyada data kyun faidemand hai?
blocks.explanation: Machine learning woh process hai jis mein algorithms ko bare data sets par train kiya jata hai taake woh trends pehchanein aur waqt ke saath behtar hon. System jitna zyada data process kare, us ke nataij (results) utne zyada durust hote hain.

items: AI: machines se woh kaam karwana jin ke liye insani zehanat chahiye.
Machine learning: data se seekhna; Neural Networks aur NLP dimagh ki tarah information process karte hain.
